requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation is incomplete and doesn't properly handle all test cases. Multiple tests fail with assertion errors due to incorrect encoding/decoding behavior, particularly for complex nested structures and various data types.
requirement.contract: Implement a complete and correct RLP encoding/decoding system that properly handles all Ethereum RLP specifications including integers, strings, and nested lists. The implementation must match expected outputs from the test suite exactly.

requirement.description: The keccak hashing implementation fails due to missing pysha3 dependency and incorrect fallback handling. Tests fail with "AttributeError: module 'hashlib' has no attribute 'keccak_256'" when trying to use hashlib directly.
requirement.contract: Ensure the keccak function properly handles all fallback scenarios including hashlib, pysha3, and pycryptodome libraries. The implementation must provide consistent keccak-256 hashing functionality regardless of available dependencies.

requirement.description: The address creation functions fail with "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rlp'" because the rlp library is not installed or available in the environment, but the code tries to import it.
requirement.contract: Implement a robust fallback mechanism for the RLP library dependency. The code should gracefully handle missing rlp library and provide alternative implementation for CREATE address derivation.

requirement.description: The format conversion utilities fail with assertion errors indicating incorrect handling of various input/output combinations. Tests fail because the conversion logic doesn't properly match expected behavior for hex string processing and type conversions.
requirement.contract: Fix the format conversion utilities to properly handle all expected input/output combinations, including raw hex, prefix hex, binary, and integer conversions. The implementation must be consistent with test expectations.

requirement.description: The CLI command execution tests fail because the command implementations are incomplete or incorrectly implemented. The tests expect proper CLI command execution behavior that isn't currently working.
requirement.contract: Ensure all CLI command implementations are complete and properly integrated with the command execution framework. The commands should execute correctly when invoked via the CLI.
